title: Mbappé, Kane and Yamal top favourites list in wide open 2026 Ballon d’Or race
summary: French forward Kylian Mbappé, England captain Harry Kane and Spain's Lamine Yamal are among the favourites to be crowned the 2026 Ballon d'Or winner at a ceremony to be hosted Monday for the first time in England in recognition of the first winner Stanley Matthews.
